item.title: CTGT releases open source tool Concordance to trace why AI agents make inconsistent decisions
item.description:
Generative AI is an incredible business advance, giving companies the opportunity to handle a wide variety of knowledge work tasks with ever-changing, inconsistent input data. But what about ensuring the outputs remain consistent and are in-line with the business goals? That's a much harder task, given, by the fundamental way in which it is designed, gen AI is "non-deterministic" — that is, outputs are constructed on the fly and may vary wildly even with the same or similar input information.

item.title: Decision models like Jev handle what SQL rules cannot. Here's how data teams use them
item.description:
Data platforms make decisions all day. An SQL query keeps the rows over a threshold, matches a keyword, and joins two tables on a shared ID. A pipeline sends a failed job down a retry path. Rules like these work when the answer sits in the data in a clean form.
